class.name: BTCallMethod
class.brief_description: BT action that calls a method on a specified [Node] or [Object].
class.description: BTCallMethod action calls a [member method] on the specified [Node] or [Object] instance and returns [code]SUCCESS[/code]. Returns [code]FAILURE[/code] if the action encounters an issue during the method execution. With [member status_from_result] the method's [bool] result becomes the status instead: [code]true[/code] returns [code]SUCCESS[/code], [code]false[/code] returns [code]FAILURE[/code].

members.member: The arguments to be passed when calling the method.
Include delta as a first parameter and shift the position of the rest of the arguments if any.
The name of the method to be called.
Specifies the [Node] or [Object] instance containing the method to be called.
if non-empty, assign the result of the method call to the blackboard variable specified by this property.

If [code]true[/code], the method is asked a question: a [bool] result decides the status ([code]true[/code] returns [code]SUCCESS[/code], [code]false[/code] returns [code]FAILURE[/code]). Any other result, [code]null[/code] included, returns [code]FAILURE[/code] with an error, because the GDExtension build cannot tell a failed call from a method that returned nothing. If [code]false[/code], the task always returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] after the call.
